Text A. Our stands are made from used boxes. The shapes are cut by our teacher, and pupils add color. Each stand holds a tablet for a presentation. You can watch this activity at two in the classroom.

Text B. Our guides are printed on the school PC and printer. Photographs were taken by pupils last week. Each guide explains the model display. Join us at three in the computer room to see the pages being prepared.

Text C. These radios were made many years ago. One was built in 1960. Visitors can read short labels about how people listened to music. This is a display, not a making activity. You may look, but you must not touch.
